mapper.select: select id, username, password, nickname, dept_id, status, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sys_user where username = #{username} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select r.role_code from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.deleted = 0 and r.status = 1

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 1 and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''
select r.data_scope from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.deleted = 0 and r.status = 1
